diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs overrepeat actions without obtaining new progress, especially clicks, no-ops/waits, and scrolling.
expected_mechanism: A state-change gate interrupts unproductive loops and forces diagnosis, an alternative action, or termination. Expected cost: observation comparison and occasional suppression of a useful retry.
policy_text: Before repeating an action on the same target, compare the latest observation with the prior one. If no relevant state changed, diagnose the blocker and choose a materially different action, request missing information, or stop. Allow one retry only when a transient-failure hypothesis is recorded.

quantitative_evidence.finding: result:repeated has +1,261 operations of candidate/bad excess, equal to 11.31% of the signed profile total; it is the second-largest flat excess.
Within repeated-result stacks, the largest action excesses are click +639, noop +356, and scroll +277; associated strategy excesses are inspect +602, wait +356, and navigate +306.
